name: Clash of Clans API
tagline: Supercell official REST API for Clash of Clans player, clan, war, and league data
description: Official Supercell REST API for Clash of Clans. Developers can query clan and player profiles, clan wars and war leagues, capital raids, leagues and rankings, locations, and labels using a free API key. Responses are JSON over HTTPS; authentication is a Bearer JWT issued after registering an IP-restricted key on the developer portal.

auth.details: JWT API key as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Keys are created on the developer portal and bound to allowed IP addresses; self-serve free signup required.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free API keys for non-commercial use; no published request quota on the developer portal (IP-restricted keys)
pricing.paid_plans: No public paid tiers; commercial use requires contacting Supercell

rate_limits: not published as fixed quotas; keys restricted to registered IP addresses; excessive use may be throttled
use_cases: look up a Clash of Clans player profile by player tag
fetch clan details, member list, and war log for a clan tag
get current clan war or clan war league group status
list top clans or players by location and league
search clans by name with filters (min members, war frequency)
